answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the knoll of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the basalt re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
